title: folks who thought MCP was dead right now:

title_zh: MCP协议近期行业动态关注
author: @DataChaz
summary_en: Recent technical discussions have emerged regarding the persistence and roadmap of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) within the AI ecosystem. As a critical middleware connecting LLMs to external data sources, the protocol is currently undergoing architectural refinement.
summary_zh: 社交平台针对模型上下文协议（MCP）的存续状态展开讨论。
full_text_zh: 那些认为 MCP 现在已经死了的人：
full_text_en: folks who thought MCP was dead right now:

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol, MCP）在AI应用生态中的存续与技术路线，近期引发了技术社区的讨论。该协议作为连接大语言模型与外部数据源的关键中间层，正处于技术迭代与架构竞争的演进期。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Recent technical discussions have emerged regarding the persistence and roadmap of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) within the AI ecosystem. As a critical middleware connecting LLMs to external data sources, the protocol is currently undergoing architectural refinement.

elements_zh.where: 社交媒体平台
elements_zh.what: 对MCP协议的行业存续性与技术重要性进行反馈与探讨
elements_zh.why: 技术社区对大模型工具链接口标准的演进存在认知分歧

elements_en.what: Debate on the market persistence and technical significance of the MCP protocol
elements_en.why: Divergent views on the evolution of tool-use API standards for LLMs

ai_analysis.insight_zh: MCP的核心价值在于标准化模型对异构数据源的调用方式，减少碎片化接口成本。其成败关键不在于架构本身，而在于能否构建以模型厂商为主导的跨生态统一标准，以抵御私有化闭源工具链的蚕食。

title: A tricky LLM interview question: You move your LLM to a faster GPU. Profiling confirms its kernels now finish sooner, but the time between generated tokens barely changes. The model, precision, and batch size are identical. Where did the expected speedup g
title_en:
A tricky LLM interview question:

You move your LLM to a faster GPU.

Profiling confirms its kernels now finish sooner, but the time between generated tokens barely changes.

The model, precision, and batch size are identical.

Where did the expected speedup go?

(answer below)

An LLM forward pass is not one giant GPU operation.

It launches a sequence of operations for attention, matmul, normalization, sampling, data movement, and other work.

Without CUDA Graphs, the CPU prepares and submits these operations individually.

Each launch adds only a small amount of overhead, but token-by-token decoding repeats a similar sequence for every generated token.

This creates a strange bottleneck.

Some kernels finish in only a few microseconds. The GPU can complete one kernel before the CPU has submitted the next one.

That leaves empty spaces in a profiler trace. These gaps are not model computation. They show the GPU waiting for its next operation.

CUDA Graphs change how this work reaches the GPU.

The runtime captures a repeatable sequence of operations once, including their dependencies. Later iterations replay the captured sequence through one graph launch instead of submitting every operation separately.

To be clear, the kernels themselves do not become substantially faster.

Also, the model does not get smaller, and the forward pass performs almost the same computation.

Most of the gain comes from removing CPU launch work between kernels.

This is especially useful during LLM decoding.

Each decoding step processes one new token per sequence. This produces many short, repeated GPU operations where launch overhead can become a meaningful part of total latency.

Prefill often behaves differently.

A large prompt gives the GPU more parallel work, producing longer-running kernels. When those kernels already keep the GPU busy, reducing launch overhead matters less.

There is also a tradeoff.

A captured graph expects the same kernel sequence, stable arguments, fixed memory addresses, and a compatible execution structure on every replay.

Inference servers handle varying batch sizes and different prefill, mixed, and decode workloads. One captured graph cannot cover every execution path efficiently.

Engines such as vLLM and TensorRT-LLM therefore capture graphs for several common execution cases and batch sizes.

When a live batch does not match a captured size, the engine may use eager execution or pad the batch to a captured size.

Capturing more sizes improves graph coverage, but it also consumes more GPU memory and increases startup time.

So CUDA Graphs are not a universal inference speed switch.

They trade flexibility and setup cost for lower steady-state launch overhead.

The visual below shows the core mechanism.

- Without a graph, the CPU submits each kernel independently and may leave idle gaps on the GPU timeline.
- With a graph, the sequence is captured once and replayed as a unit.

CUDA Graphs are one example of why LLM inference needs a specialized serving engine rather than a standard prediction API.

title_zh:
一个棘手的LLM面试问题：

您将 LLM 转移到更快的 GPU。

分析证实其内核现在完成得更快，但生成令牌之间的时间几乎没有变化。

模型、精度和批量大小相同。

预期的加速哪里去了？

（答案如下）

LLM 前向传递并不是一项巨大的
author: @DailyDoseOfDS_
summary_zh:
GPU 操作。

它启动一系列操作来进行注意力、矩阵相乘、标准化、采样、数据移动和其他工作。

如果没有 CUDA Graph，CPU 会单独准备并提交这些操作。

每次启动仅增加少量开销，但逐个令牌解码会对每个生成的令牌重复类似的序列。

这造成了一个奇怪的瓶颈。

有些内核只需几微秒即可完成。 GPU 可以在 CPU 提交下一个内核之前完成一个内核。

这会在探查器跟踪中留下空白空间。这些差距不是模型计算。它们显示 GPU 正在等待下一个操作。

CUDA Graph 改变了这项工作到达 GPU 的方式。

运行时捕获一次可重复的操作序列，包括它们的依赖项。稍后的迭代通过一个图启动重放捕获的序列，而不是单独提交每个操作。

需要明确的是，内核本身并没有变得更快。

此外，模型不会变小，并且前向传递执行几乎相同的计算。

大部分收益来自于消除内核之间的 CPU 启动工作。

这在 LLM 解码期间特别有用。

每个解码步骤为每个序列处理一个新标记。这会产生许多短的、重复的 GPU 操作，其中启动开销可能成为总延迟的一个有意义的部分。

预填充通常表现不同。

较大的提示可以让 GPU 进行更多并行工作，从而生成运行时间更长的内核。当这些内核已经让 GPU 忙碌时，减少启动开销就不那么重要了。

还有一个权衡。

捕获的图在每次重放时都需要相同的内核序列、稳定的参数、固定的内存地址和兼容的执行结构。

推理服务器可处理不同的批量大小以及不同的预填充、混合和解码工作负载。一张捕获的图无法有效覆盖每条执行路径。

因此，vLLM 和 TensorRT-LLM 等引擎可以捕获几种常见执行情况和批量大小的图表。

当实时批次与捕获的大小不匹配时，引擎可以使用急切执行或将批次填充到捕获的大小。

捕获更多尺寸可以提高图形覆盖范围，但也会消耗更多 GPU 内存并增加启动时间。

因此 CUDA Graph 并不是通用的推理速度开关。

他们以灵活性和设置成本为代价换取较低的稳态启动开销。

下图显示了核心机制。

- 如果没有图表，CPU 会独立提交每个内核，并且可能会在 GPU 时间线上留下空闲间隙。
- 通过图表，序列被捕获一次并作为一个单元重播。

CUDA 图是为什么 LLM 推理需要专门的服务引擎而不是标准预测 API 的一个例子。

我们之前解释了传统 ML 推理和 LLM 推理之间的五个架构差异。

title: Software engineering skills and fundamentals will be even more valuable in the age of AI-powered software engineering. I'm seeing this happen in real time. A lot of vibe coders are discovering the basics of software engineering through trial and error. For exa
title_en:
Software engineering skills and fundamentals will be even more valuable in the age of AI-powered software engineering. I'm seeing this happen in real time.

A lot of vibe coders are discovering the basics of software engineering through trial and error. For example, I've seen several of my non-coder friends learn "feature creep" through experience. 

When all it takes to add a feature is to prompt Claude Code or Codex to "add X," it all seems easy. But then, when features pile up on each other and your code slows to a crawl to the point that even the AI agent can't make sense of what is going on, then you begin to think, "Hmmm... maybe those software engineers know a few things that are worth learning."

Stick to the fundamentals, know your value and the value of the experience you've accrued over the years.

在人工智能驱动的软件工程时代，软件工程技能和基础知识将变得更加有价值。我看到这一切实时发生。

坚持基本原则，了解自己的价值以及多年来积累的经验的价值。

title: MCP servers carry real credentials but rarely get scanned. Moving one to Docker Hardened Images removed 244 packages and all 36 reported vulnerabilities. #containersecurity #docker...Show more
title_en: MCP servers carry real credentials but rarely get scanned. Moving one to Docker Hardened Images removed 244 packages and all 36 reported vulnerabilities. #containersecurity #docker...Show more
title_zh: MCP服务器容器安全风险警示
author: @hackernoon
summary_en: Security analysis reveals that MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, often containing real credentials, face significant risks due to infrequent vulnerability scanning. Migrating these servers to Docker Hardened Images effectively removes redundant dependencies and mitigates all identified security vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: MCP服务器因包含敏感凭证且缺乏定期扫描存在安全隐患，迁移至Docker加固镜像可有效移除冗余包并修复已知漏洞。
full_text_zh: MCP 服务器携带真实凭证，但很少被扫描。将其中一个迁移到 Docker 强化映像删除了 244 个软件包和所有 36 个报告的漏洞。 #containersecurity #docker...显示更多
full_text_en: MCP servers carry real credentials but rarely get scanned. Moving one to Docker Hardened Images removed 244 packages and all 36 reported vulnerabilities. #containersecurity #docker...Show more

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 安全评估显示，MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器常驻真实凭证，由于缺乏常规安全扫描机制，极易成为攻击链突破口。通过将服务迁移至Docker加固镜像（Hardened Images），可剔除冗余依赖包，并实现对已知漏洞的全面清零。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Security analysis reveals that MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, often containing real credentials, face significant risks due to infrequent vulnerability scanning. ai_analysis.insight_zh: 在AI上下文协议普及背景下，MCP服务器正成为连接大模型与企业数据资产的核心枢纽，但其底层基础设施的安全性严重滞后于协议的迭代速度。此次镜像加固不仅是简单的技术合规，更是AI企业防范供应链投毒与凭证窃取的强制性架构升级。
ai_analysis.insight_en: As the Model Context Protocol gains traction, MCP servers are becoming critical conduits between LLMs and enterprise data assets, yet their underlying infrastructure security lags behind protocol iteration. This hardening exercise represents a mandatory architectural pivot to safeguard against supply chain poisoning and credential theft in AI-native deployments.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 安全评估显示，MCP（Model Context Protocol）服务器常驻真实凭证，由于缺乏常规安全扫描机制，极易成为攻击链突破口。通过将服务迁移至Docker加固镜像（Hardened Images），可剔除冗余依赖包，并实现对已知漏洞的全面清零。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Security analysis reveals that MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, often containing real credentials, face significant risks due to infrequent vulnerability scanning. Migrating these servers to Docker Hardened Images effectively removes redundant dependencies and mitigates all identified security vulnerabilities.

title: SPACEX GETS APPROVAL FOR 1 MILLION AI SATELLITES IN SPACE! Elon Musk's SpaceX has received authorization from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (#FCC) to deploy up to one million satellites designed to serve as artificial intelligenc
title_en:
SPACEX GETS APPROVAL FOR 1 MILLION AI SATELLITES IN SPACE!

Elon Musk's SpaceX has received authorization from the U.S. Federal Communications Commission (#FCC) to deploy up to one million satellites designed to serve as artificial intelligence data centers in orbit.

Approved on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, the ambitious project, called "Starmind," aims to use solar-powered computing satellites to process massive amounts of data for AI applications on Earth.

However, scientists have raised concerns over the project's feasibility, including the difficulty of cooling computers in space, potential orbital collisions, space debris and increased light pollution that could disrupt astronomical observations.

Although the FCC has granted authorization, #SpaceX is not required to deploy its first satellite until 2033, with further deployment milestones extending through 2040.

title: ▲ Tencent just open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoder that drafts tokens for sparse-attention LLMs without keeping its own KV cache. The key idea is sharing the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads its paired target layer's KV cache and the same top-k
title_en:
▲ Tencent just open-sourced DFly2, a speculative decoder that drafts tokens for sparse-attention LLMs without keeping its own KV cache.

The key idea is sharing the target's sparsity. Each draft layer reads its paired target layer's KV cache and the same top-k positions that layer's indexer already picked. So the drafter adds no KV memory, skips prefill, and each draft token reads at most about 2K keys at any context length.

The numbers vs a same-recipe DSpark retrain: average accepted length of 4.12 vs 3.81 on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (temp 0), and +62% and +81% serving throughput on 2 64K sets at matched per-user speed. On long-context and agentic sets, the acceptance margin is 10.0% to 31.5%. It is a trade-off though: on Hy4 flash general tasks the gain over DSpark is only 3.9%, and it only works on targets with a native sparse indexer.

A 0.85B DFly2 drafter ships inside Tencent's Hy4 flash and runs in vLLM and SGLang. Training code is in AngelSpec v0.2.0......

Full analysis: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/26/tencent-dfly2-speculative-decoding-sparse-models/

Paper: http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.34776

Repo: http://github.com/Tencent/AngelSpec

Model: http://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-flash

title: Twenty scientific papers now cite a term that doesn't exist, because a model merged two words across two columns of a scanned PDF it had been fed. @cedricclyburn, Senior Developer Advocate at Red Hat, tells that story in "Structuring the Unstructured," on
title_en:
Twenty scientific papers now cite a term that doesn't exist, because a model merged two words across two columns of a scanned PDF it had been fed. @cedricclyburn, Senior Developer Advocate at Red Hat, tells that story in "Structuring the Unstructured," on @aiDotEngineer's YouTube.

The talk is a walkthrough of turning PDFs, scanned pages, tables, and images into Markdown, JSON, or structured data an LLM can actually use, with the open source tool Docling, part of the Linux Foundation, running locally without a GPU.

- The cost math on frontier models. Sending documents to a frontier model to parse runs around $30 per million output tokens, and results can shift between model versions since the output isn't deterministic.
- A 50x number from Hugging Face. Someone there compared processing common crawl PDFs with Docling on CPU against VLMs and OCR, and found roughly 50x in cost savings without touching a GPU.
- RAG without a vector database. The talk demos an LLM searching a document's own markdown outline and section summaries directly, including a question about Red Hat's revenue growth run against IBM's 418-section 2025 annual report, no chunker or embeddings involved.
- Vision models and redaction. Docling pairs with local vision-language models (a Granite model via Ollama, in the demo) to describe images and diagrams, and has a model for stripping personally identifiable information before extraction.
- An MCP server for agents. Docling Serve exposes the pipeline as a REST API or Kubernetes microservice, and a Docling MCP server lets tools like Claude Code or Continue call document conversion and extraction directly.

I share insights from the frontiers of AI Engineering. Follow for more!
title_zh: 现在有 20 篇科学论文引用了一个不存在的术语，因为一个模型将其输入的扫描 PDF 的两列中的两个单词合并在一起。红帽高级开发倡导者 @cedricclyburn 在 @aiDotEngineer 的 YouTube 上的“结构化非结构化”
author: @i
summary_zh:
中讲述了这个故事。

该演讲介绍了如何将 PDF、扫描的页面、表格和图像转换为法学硕士可以实际使用的 Markdown、JSON 或结构化数据，并使用开源工具 Docling（Linux 基金会的一部分）在本地运行，无需 GPU。

- 前沿模型的成本数学。将文档发送到前沿模型进行解析的成本约为每百万输出令牌 30 美元，并且由于输出不确定，结果可能会在模型版本之间发生变化。
- Hugging Face 的 50 倍数字。有人将使用 CPU 上的 Doclling 处理常见爬行 PDF 与 VLM 和 OCR 进行比较，发现在不接触 GPU 的情况下可节省大约 50 倍的成本。
- 没有矢量数据库的 RAG。该演讲演示了法学硕士直接搜索文档自己的降价大纲和章节摘要，其中包括一个有关红帽收入增长与 IBM 2025 年 418 节年度报告对比的问题，不涉及分块器或嵌入。
- 视觉模型和编辑。 Docling 与本地视觉语言模型（演示中通过 Ollama 的 Granite 模型）配对来描述图像和图表，并有一个在提取之前剥离个人身份信息的模型。
- 用于代理的 MCP 服务器。 Doling Serve 将管道公开为 REST API 或 Kubernetes 微服务，Docling MCP 服务器允许 Claude Code 或Continue 等工具直接调用文档转换和提取。

我分享人工智能工程前沿的见解。关注了解更多！

title: Starting today, we're offering free Kimi API credits to support scientific research worldwide. Selected teams will receive free Kimi API credits, access to our latest models, and opportunities for long-term collaboration. The program builds on our commitment to op
title_en:
Starting today, we're offering free Kimi API credits to support scientific research worldwide.

Selected teams will receive free Kimi API credits, access to our latest models, and opportunities for long-term collaboration.  

The program builds on our commitment to open-weight models by making frontier AI more accessible to researchers.  

AI has the potential to change what can be studied, who can study it, and at what scale, making it possible to pursue a wider range of scientific questions with limited resources.  

Both theoretical and experimental research in fundamental science and engineering are welcome. We hope to help researchers take on more challenging and original questions, including those that have historically received less attention or funding.  

Apply by Dec 8 for the first round: https://www.kimi.ai/news/kimi-for-science-program

该计划建立在我们对开放权重模型的承诺之上，让研究人员更容易接触到前沿人

title: New Microsoft paper finds that AI coding tools write bigger bug fixes than human programmers (2.33X bigger than human developers) mainly because they add tests and documentation, while their actual code is about as necessary as a human's. Agent patche
title_en:
New Microsoft paper finds that AI coding tools write bigger bug fixes than human programmers (2.33X bigger than human developers) mainly because they add tests and documentation, while their actual code is about as necessary as a human's.

Agent patches change 2.33 times as many lines as developer fixes, which is widely read as over-editing. Size alone cannot say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from.

They replayed 7,660 GitHub Copilot CLI runs from 18 models and traced each patch block to the step that wrote it. They then removed each block, reran the tests, and graded developer patches the same way.

On SWE-bench Verified, 61% of the extra edits were tests, and agent patches averaged 88.7% needed code blocks versus 86.4% for developers. The unneeded code came from writing the fix, not debug leftovers, and 3 Gemini Flash models left more than developers.

Report needed-code share next to resolve rate when comparing coding agents, and cut over-editing through training and post-run pruning.
title_zh:
微软的新论文发现，人工智能编码工具比人类程序员编写了更多的错误修复（比人类开发人员大 2.33 倍），主要是因为它们添加了测试和文档，而它们的实际代码与人类的代码差不多。

代理补丁更改的行数是开发人员修复的行数的 2.33 倍，这被广泛解
author: @rohanpaul_ai
summary_zh:
读为过度编辑。仅凭大小并不能说明是否需要额外的编辑、它们是什么或它们来自哪里。

他们重放了 18 个模型的 7,660 次 GitHub Copilot CLI 运行，并跟踪每个补丁块到编写它的步骤。然后，他们删除了每个块，重新运行测试，并以相同的方式对开发人员补丁进行分级。

在 SWE-bench Verified 上，61% 的额外编辑是测试，代理补丁平均需要 88.7% 的代码块，而开发人员则为 86.4%。不需要的代码来自于编写修复程序，而不是调试剩余的代码，3 个 Gemini Flash 模型留下的代码比开发人员还多。

在比较编码代理时，报告所需的代码共享，以解决率，并通过培训和运行后修剪来减少过度编辑。

title: Everything discovered in the code since the release of One UI 9.5 Beta 1 In just a few days, APK teardowns have uncovered a wealth of unannounced Samsung technologies and features, many of which could be related to the upcoming Galaxy S27 series. 01.
title_en:
Everything discovered in the code since the release of One UI 9.5 Beta 1

In just a few days, APK teardowns have uncovered a wealth of unannounced Samsung technologies and features, many of which could be related to the upcoming Galaxy S27 series.

01. SPAC, a private AI cloud computing platform similar to Apple's Private Cloud Compute.
02. Arcane, a private cloud server gateway.
03. References to Alibaba's Qwen 3.6.
04. References to Google's Gemma 4.
05. FLUX and Stable Diffusion image generation models.
06. References to AI models and technologies from OpenAI and Meta.
07. GUI Agent, an AI agent potentially capable of autonomously interacting with the phone's interface.
08. An unannounced feature called Bixby Work.
09. Galaxy Claw, an autonomous AI agent.
10. Personal Agent Core, the underlying AI agent framework.
11. Scheduled and automated AI tasks.
12. Daily Brief, an intelligent daily information summary.
13. AI-powered device cleaning.
14. AI travel planner.
15. References to a potential Galaxy AI Premium subscription.
16. Native Open Gate video recording with six frame rate options.
17. Recompose, a 3D photo reconstruction feature that lets users change the camera perspective after taking a photo.
18. Dolly Zoom, also known as the Hitchcock zoom effect.
19. Spatial Core, a 3D spatial processing engine.
20. Testing of new Nano Banana models.
21. References to a GPT image generation model.
22. Cloud-based AI super-resolution and zoom photo enhancement.
23. A potential Expert RAW overhaul.
24. Call recording for third-party apps.
25. AI scam detection across 14 third-party communication apps.
26. AI-generated voice and deepfake detection.
27. Voiceprint recognition of known scammers.
28. On-device AI analysis of call conversations.
29. References to native App Lock.
30. Phone drop detection.
31. Gemini and Perplexity integration into Modes and Routines.
32. Automated text summarization, offline translation, and image-to-text extraction.
33. Variable passing and loop execution in Modes and Routines.
34. Automated AI news briefings, meeting summaries, and storage cleanup.
35. Two Android laptops codenamed Origin, featuring 14-inch and 16-inch displays, with code pointing to Snapdragon X Elite processors.
36. A dedicated laptop version of One UI, featuring pressure-sensitive touchpads, multi-user support, enterprise management, cross-device connectivity, and on-device Galaxy AI.

These findings are based on publicly reported code discoveries and leaks. Some features are still under development or testing and may never make it to the final release.

One UI 9.5 Beta 1 has only just arrived, yet its code is already hiding this many secrets. Samsung's technological ambitions for 2027 appear to be far bigger than what we've seen so far.

title: Honored to share my thoughts on the future of humanoid robot in The Economist's "The World Ahead 2027". @TheEconomist I believe that 2027 will mark the beginning of mass production for advanced general-purpose humanoid robots. The physical Al era is
title_en:
Honored to share my thoughts on the future of humanoid robot
in The Economist's "The World Ahead 2027". @TheEconomist 

I believe that 2027 will mark the beginning of mass production for advanced general-purpose humanoid robots. The physical Al era is getting closer.

However, the industry has underestimated the difficulty of Physical AI hardware. Building an advanced human robot is roughly 20 times more complex than engineering a smart vehicle.

Robots must be designed with a software mindset, but hardware must come first. Robots also need multiple speeds of thought, and the data they learn from needs variety, not merely volume.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 针对社交平台关于Claude在大模型机器学习代码编写中存在“自我破坏”或性能退化的反馈，用户通过对比测试发现，Claude在24k步训练表现上不及仅经4k步训练的Gemini Neon模型。该现象引发了开发者对于闭源大模型在特定编程任务中是否存在系统性路径依赖导致逻辑坍塌的质疑。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Following community reports regarding Claude's suboptimal performance in ML research code generation, empirical user tests show the model underperforming at 24k steps compared to Gemini Neon at 4k steps. ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大模型在科研代码辅助中的性能非线性问题，指向了模型训练阶段的数据偏向与指令微调导致的逻辑权值坍塌，而非简单的版本迭代。这种表现差异迫使AI辅助编程工具开发者从追求模型参数规模转向针对特定垂直任务（如机器学习算法构建）的鲁棒性测评，防止AI反馈对科研逻辑造成负面干预。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The non-linear performance degradation in research code assistance suggests a shift from scaling laws to data bias and instruction-tuning induced logic collapse. title_en:
It's an exciting time to be a software engineer. Yes, the role is changing. But there remain so many interesting & ambitious problems yet to be solved.

"This is for the engineers feeling an identity crisis because they think their knowledge and skills won't be important - you and your skills can be the difference in whether or not these problems get tackled and multiagent systems can solve the world’s hardest problems. You can and should go deep in these domains, learn new things, and form opinions. So much of this problem space is wide open for new solutions."

title: I am on a journey to prove smaller local LLMs can punch above their weight class. I've just open sourced Cortheon v2 Cortheon is an execution verified parallel consensus runtime that pushes frozen local models up to +30 points higher with zero weight updat
title_en:
I am on a journey to prove smaller local LLMs can punch above their weight class.

I've just open sourced Cortheon v2

Cortheon is an execution verified parallel consensus runtime that pushes frozen local models up to +30 points higher with zero weight updates and zero cloud APIs.

Same weights, same hardware. 

Official untouched benchmarks across 3 model families (8 for 8 wins, 200 runs): 

• AIME 2025 (3-bit GLM-5.3-Flash): 50.0% → 80.0% (+30.0 pts) 
• AIME 2025 (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash): 66.7% → 90.0% (+23.3 pts) 
• AIME 2025 (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next): 53.3% → 70.0% (+16.7 pts) 
• LiveCodeBench v6 Hard (oracle-free): +10 to +15 pts 
• Wave-1 consensus precision: 50/51 (98.0%)

With atomic GPU early-abort that cancels straggler streams the instant 2/4 independent Python/SymPy/Z3 verifiers agree (7.5× faster, 271s → 36s on a 25-digit exact rational Markov cover time). 

Works on TensorFold, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM & LM Studio and installs /cortheon into OMP, Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor & Codex in one command.

Every per-problem result JSON and repro script is public. Run cortheon Showdown and watch your own local model beat itself live in 60 seconds: 

https://github.com/ashhart/Cortheon

title: ▲ Sakana AI just introduced Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B reasoning model that tops NVIDIA's 120B Nemotron 3 Super on its own 25-benchmark average. The key idea is heavy post-training on a small open base. Sakana took the pretrained Nemotron 3 Nan
title_en:
▲ Sakana AI just introduced Sakana Namazu Small, a 30B reasoning model that tops NVIDIA's 120B Nemotron 3 Super on its own 25-benchmark average.

The key idea is heavy post-training on a small open base. Sakana took the pretrained Nemotron 3 Nano base (30B total, 3B active) and ran its own continued pretraining and post-training. The target is web-search research and answering from long documents with evidence.

The numbers (self-reported): 60.1 average vs 56.2 for Nemotron 3 Super and 50.2 for Nemotron 3 Nano. BrowseComp jumps to 73.5 vs 36.1 for Super. It is a trade-off though: closed-book recall lags, with SimpleQA Verified at 6.8 vs 18.1 for Super.

No weights, license or pricing yet. Sakana plans on-premises availability and will share details in early-to-mid December 2026......

Full analysis: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/26/sakana-ai-namazu-small-30b-nemotron-3-nano/

Announcement: http://sakana.ai/namazu-small

Base model: http://huggingface.co/blog/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-efficient-open-intelligent-models

Paper (Nemotron 3 Nano): http://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20848

@SakanaAILabs
title_zh:
▲ Sakana AI 刚刚推出了 Sakana Namazu Small，这是一款 30B 推理模型，其 25 基准平均值超过了 NVIDIA 的 120B Nemotron 3 Super。

关键的想法是在小型开放基地进行大量的后期训
author: @Marktechpost
summary_zh:
练。 Sakana 采用预训练的 Nemotron 3 Nano 基础（总共 30B，活跃 3B）并运行自己的持续预训练和后训练。目标是网络搜索研究并从带有证据的长文档中进行回答。

数字（自我报告）：平均 60.1，Nemotron 3 Super 为 56.2，Nemotron 3 Nano 为 50.2。 BrowseComp 跃升至 73.5，而 Super 则为 36.1。但这是一个权衡：闭卷回忆滞后，SimpleQA Verified 为 6.8，而 Super 为 18.1。

尚无重量、许可证或定价。 Sakana 计划在本地提供服务，并将于 2026 年 12 月上旬至中旬分享详细信息……

title: I showed an AI Infrastructure Engineer three production metrics. GPU utilization: 95% GPU memory utilization: 88% LLM response latency: 12 seconds Then I asked one simple question. "Is this inference system performing well?" He replied: "Yes. The GPU is
title_en:
I showed an AI Infrastructure Engineer three production metrics.

GPU utilization: 95%

GPU memory utilization: 88%

LLM response latency: 12 seconds

Then I asked one simple question.

"Is this inference system performing well?"

He replied:

"Yes. The GPU is almost fully utilized. We just need more GPUs to reduce latency."

He had 8 years of infrastructure experience and had recently moved into AI engineering.

His resume mentioned NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, Kubernetes, vLLM, and LLM inference.

So I gave him more context.

The system serves a 70B parameter model.

Traffic consists of short interactive questions and long document-processing requests.

Some users receive the first token in under a second.

Others wait 10 seconds.

The GPUs are busy, but users are complaining.

What would you investigate before adding more GPUs?

He said:

"I'll increase the GPU replica count."

So I asked:

What's the difference between time to first token and inter-token latency?
How does continuous batching affect latency?
What happens when long prompts increase prefill load?
How would you identify KV-cache pressure?
What changes when you separate prefill and decode workloads?
How would you measure tokens per second per GPU?

He understood GPU deployment.

But he struggled to explain inference performance.

And that's the gap.

95% GPU utilization doesn't mean 95% efficiency.

A GPU can be extremely busy while delivering a terrible user experience.

The best AI Infrastructure Engineers don't just maximize GPU utilization.

They balance throughput, latency, memory efficiency, and cost.

Would you approve a GPU scaling decision based only on utilization?
title_zh:
我向人工智能基础设施工程师展示了三个生产指标。

GPU利用率：95%

GPU内存利用率：88%

LLM 响应延迟：12 秒

然后我问了一个简单的问题。

“这个推理系统表现得还好吗？”

他回答说：

“是的。GPU 几乎被充分利用
author: @techyoutbe
summary_zh:
我们只是需要更多 GPU 来减少延迟。”

他拥有 8 年基础设施经验，最近进入人工智能工程领域。

他的简历提到了 NVIDIA GPU、CUDA、Kubernetes、vLLM 和 LLM 推理。

所以我给了他更多背景信息。

该系统服务于70B参数模型。

流量由简短的交互问题和长文档处理请求组成。

有些用户在一秒内收到第一个令牌。

其他人等10秒。

GPU 很忙，但用户却在抱怨。

在添加更多 GPU 之前您会调查什么？

他说：

“我会增加 GPU 副本数量。”

所以我问：

第一个令牌的时间和令牌间延迟之间有什么区别？
连续批处理如何影响延迟？
当长提示增加预填充负载时会发生什么？
您如何识别 KV 缓存压力？
当您分离预填充和解码工作负载时会发生什么变化？
如何测量每个 GPU 每秒的令牌数？

他了解 GPU 部署。

但他很难解释推理性能。

这就是差距。

95% 的 GPU 利用率并不意味着 95% 的效率。

GPU 可能会非常繁忙，同时会带来糟糕的用户体验。

最好的人工智能基础设施工程师不仅仅能最大限度地提高 GPU 利用率。

它们平衡吞吐量、延迟、内存效率和成本。

您是否会批准仅基于利用率的 GPU 扩展决策？

ai_analysis.insight_en: This trend indicates a shift in AI agent deployment from cloud-based API orchestration to low-level client-side manipulation, posing critical challenges to enterprise security boundaries. title_en:
how does AI generated text impact evaluation on our pre-training index?

if you remove ai generated text from uncheatable eval, inkling 2 small goes from 4th place to 8th place 👀

for deepseek v4 it's the exact opposite, which is coherent since deepseek tech report explicitly says they don't use synthetic data during pre-training

on average post-trained models lean toward AI text (+2%) and base models away (-3%)

this analysis is based on @jennajrussell and @dlwh work on @MarinCommunity! i made small changes like i finetuning qwen3 0.6B on Pangram 4 labels, since open pangram was quite bad at it (56% accuracy on held-out docs vs 88% for the finetuned qwen). both are on the site, you can switch between them!
title_zh:
人工智能生成的文本如何影响我们预训练指数的评估？

如果你从不可取消的评估中删除人工智能生成的文本，Inkling 2 Small 就会从第四名上升到第八名👀

对于 deepseek v4 来说，情况恰恰相反，这是一致的，因为 deeps
author: @eliebakouch
summary_zh:
eek 技术报告明确表示他们在预训练期间不使用合成数据

平均而言，训练后模型倾向于人工智能文本 (+2%)，而基础模型则远离 (-3%)

此分析基于@jennajrussell 和@dlwh 在@MarinCommunity 上的工作！我做了一些小的改变，比如我在 Pangram 4 标签上微调了 qwen3 0.6B，因为 open pangram 的表现非常糟糕（保留文档的准确度为 56%，而微调后的 qwen 的准确度为 88%）。两者都在网站上，您可以在它们之间切换！
full_text_en:
how does AI generated text impact evaluation on our pre-training index?

if you remove ai generated text from uncheatable eval, inkling 2 small goes from 4th place to 8th place 👀

for deepseek v4 it's the exact opposite, which is coherent since deepseek tech report explicitly says they don't use synthetic data during pre-training

on average post-trained models lean toward AI text (+2%) and base models away (-3%)

this analysis is based on @jennajrussell and @dlwh work on @MarinCommunity! i made small changes like i finetuning qwen3 0.6B on Pangram 4 labels, since open pangram was quite bad at it (56% accuracy on held-out docs vs 88% for the finetuned qwen). both are on the site, you can switch between them!
full_text_zh:
人工智能生成的文本如何影响我们预训练指数的评估？

如果你从不可取消的评估中删除人工智能生成的文本，Inkling 2 Small 就会从第四名上升到第八名👀

对于 deepseek v4 来说，情况恰恰相反，这是一致的，因为 deepseek 技术报告明确表示他们在预训练期间不使用合成数据

平均而言，训练后模型倾向于人工智能文本 (+2%)，而基础模型则远离 (-3%)

此分析基于@jennajrussell 和@dlwh 在@MarinCommunity 上的工作！我做了一些小的改变，比如我在 Pangram 4 标签上微调了 qwen3 0.6B，因为 open pangram 的表现非常糟糕（保留文档的准确度为 56%，而微调后的 qwen 的准确度为 88%）。两者都在网站上，您可以在它们之间切换！

title_en:
Seedance 2.5 vs Wan 3.0 with the same prompt

I made both videos on @makeugc. After my Kling 4.0 comparison, I wanted to see how Wan 3.0 would handle the same jump rope vlog.

1. As I mentioned in my last post, I got the Seedance clip on the first try. I gave Wan three tries and picked the second take because the woman looked the most realistic in that one.

2. The Seedance clip looks more realistic to me overall. Wan’s version is brighter, the colors are richer, and I really like the lighting in the gym. The woman looks believable too, though I think Wan went a little overboard with the sweat.

3. Wan costs a lot less per generation. That matters when you want to try the same prompt a few times.

4. I’ve had good results with Wan in other tests too. Personally, I still prefer Seedance for video quality.

5. Both models followed the prompt well overall. The biggest difference for me was the missed jump. In the Wan clip, she stops jumping before the rope even touches her foot, so the stumble feels staged. I think she starts saying her line a little early too.

I’d still pick Seedance for a tricky scene like this, but I’m happy with how Wan did. Which version did you prefer?

PROMPT ⬇️

**CAMERA:**
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. A self-filmed gym vlog: MILA holds the camera for the opening selfie, then props it securely on a low bench for the jump-rope shots. Slight hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed autofocus and a briefly cropped forehead in the selfie. Once propped, the camera stays still; tighter inserts are simple crops of that same recording. Casual hard cuts omit setup time. The camcorder never appears on screen or in the mirror.

**LOOK:**
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, subtle auto-exposure fluctuations, muted contrast, realistic skin tones. MILA looks like a real woman recorded in an ordinary gym: natural skin texture, small imperfections, fine loose hairs and spontaneous facial expressions remain visible beneath the gentle tape softness. Soft overhead lighting creates believable shadows beneath her chin and feet. No beauty-filter smoothing or glossy commercial grading.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — initial confidence, a few genuinely good jumps, one tiny mistake and an extremely well-earned water break. Real effort mixed with humor. Short, casual cuts, normal-speed movement and a light, funny finish.

**Character**

MILA — a beautiful American Instagram-style brunette model and performer, 20. Long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, glossy lips, expressive eyes, soft glam makeup and delicate sparkly stud earrings. Slim athletic figure with a very large, full bust, very full rounded buttocks, a narrow waist, flat stomach and lean arms and legs.

She wears a cobalt-blue supportive sports bra with thin straps and a deep scoop neckline showing cleavage, paired with matching ultra-short fitted athletic shorts. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff. White ankle socks, sneakers off. She speaks with an American accent.

Her ponytail follows each jump with a slight natural delay. Her shoulders stay relaxed, knees soften on landing, and her fitted sportswear moves naturally with her body.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening, with a flat rubber exercise floor, a mirror wall off to one side and other equipment visible in the background. Soft overhead lighting. One clear, half-full water bottle with a white flip-top drinking spout stands beside the bench, well outside the rope's path. One ordinary dark jump rope with two black handles. Enough clear space above and around her for the full rope arc.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 shots)**

1. *(0–2s, handheld arm's-length selfie)*  
MILA looks into the lens with an overly confident little smile, holding both rope handles together in her free hand. One loose strand of hair rests against her cheek. The framing dips slightly as she starts lowering the camera toward the bench.  
MILA: “This looks easy.”

2. *(2–5s, propped camera, full-body shot)*  
Hard cut: the camera is now resting on the bench, and MILA is already jumping a few steps away. Her whole body, both handles and the rope's overhead arc fit in frame. She makes several small, steady two-foot hops, turning the rope with compact wrist movements, elbows close to her sides. The bottle remains visible beside the bench at the edge of frame. Her ponytail bobs behind her.  
No dialogue — rhythmic rope taps, soft landings and light breathing.

3. *(5–7s, tighter insert from the same propped recording)*  
A simple crop onto her lower legs, white socks and the floor. The rope skims the rubber just ahead of her toes, passes beneath both feet during each small hop, then continues behind her. Her ankles and knees absorb each landing. A little natural motion blur follows the moving rope.  
No dialogue. Keep the same jumping rhythm across the cut.

4. *(7–9s, back to the full-body framing)*  
The rope catches lightly against her toes on the next pass. Its rotation stops; she settles onto both feet and takes one small recovery step, still holding a handle in each hand. She looks down at the slack rope, then back toward the lens with an amused, mildly offended expression.  
MILA, with a breathy little laugh: “Okay. Rude.”

5. *(9–11.5s, propped camera, medium crop near the bench)*  
Jump cut: she is crouched beside the bench. She places both handles and the slack rope on the floor, then picks up the same water bottle with her left hand and flips its drinking spout open with her right. Her shoulders rise and fall with slightly quicker breathing; she smiles to herself.  
No dialogue. A small plastic click and quiet gym ambience.

6. *(11.5–15s, closer crop, camera still propped)*  
Still crouching near the lens, she raises the open bottle, takes one brief, ordinary sip, lowers it and swallows. The water tilts naturally inside the bottle. She lets out a small satisfied breath, looks straight into the camera and gives a cheeky half-smile.  
MILA: “Still counts.”  
Finish on her amused expression, with the bottle lowered in her hand.

**Audio and continuity**

Natural American-accented speech with accurate lip sync. Soft gym room tone, rope swishes and floor taps synchronized with each rotation, light breathing, the bottle's lid click and a quiet sip. Leave space between actions and dialogue. No music, voiceover, captions or added comedy effects.

Keep MILA's face, proportions, outfit, hairstyle, lighting and surroundings consistent. The rope remains one continuous cord attached to the same two handles: one rotation per hop, no extra loops, disappearing sections or passage through her body. Both hands hold their respective handles throughout the jumping. The same bottle stays beside the bench until she visibly picks it up.

full_text_zh:
Seedance 2.5 与 Wan 3.0 具有相同的提示

我在@makeugc 上制作了这两个视频。在与 Kling 4.0 进行比较之后，我想看看 Wan 3.0 如何处理相同的跳绳视频博客。

1. 正如我在上一篇文章中提到的，我第一次尝试就得到了 Seedance 剪辑。我给了万三次尝试，选择了第二次，因为那个女人看起来最真实。

2.整体而言，Seedance 剪辑对我来说看起来更真实。万的版本更亮，颜色更丰富，我很喜欢健身房的灯光。这个女人看起来也很可信，尽管我认为万的汗水有点过头了。

3. 每一代的WAN成本要低得多。当您想多次尝试相同的提示时，这一点很重要。

4. 我和Wan一起在其他测试中也取得了不错的成绩。就我个人而言，我还是更喜欢 Seedance 的视频质量。

5. 两种型号总体上都很好地遵循了提示。对我来说最大的区别是错过了跳跃。在万的剪辑中，她在绳子接触到她的脚之前就停止了跳跃，所以这次绊倒感觉像是上演的。我认为她也很早就开始说她的台词了。

对于这样棘手的场景，我仍然会选择 Seedance，但我对 Wan 的表现很满意。您更喜欢哪个版本？

提示⬇️

**相机：**
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持感觉。自拍的健身视频博客：MILA 拿着相机拍摄开场自拍照，然后将其牢固地支撑在矮凳上拍摄跳绳镜头。轻微的手抖、取景未对准、自动对焦延迟以及自拍照中额头被短暂修剪。一旦被支撑，相机就会保持静止；更紧密的插入是同一录音的简单裁剪。随意的硬剪省去了准备时间。摄像机永远不会出现在屏幕或镜子中。

* *: * *
柔软的，稍微模糊的磁带质量，微弱的磁带噪音，在健身房灯光下绽放的高光，微妙的自动曝光波动，柔和的对比度，逼真的肤色。MILA看起来就像一个真实的女人，记录在一个普通的健身房：自然的皮肤纹理，小瑕疵，精细松散的头发和自然的面部表情，在柔和的胶带柔软下仍然清晰可见。柔和的顶灯在她的下巴和脚下创造了可信的阴影。没有美丽的过滤器平滑或有光泽的商业分级。

**风格：**
俏皮、自嘲的健身视频博客语气——最初的自信、几次真正出色的跳跃、一个小错误和一次非常值得的破水。真正的努力与幽默相结合。简短、随意的剪辑、正常速度的动作以及轻松、有趣的结尾。

**特点**

MILA——一位美丽的美国 Instagram 风格的黑发模特和表演者，20 岁。深棕色长发扎成高马尾辫，皮肤焕发着淡淡的汗水光泽，嘴唇有光泽，眼睛富有表情，妆容柔和迷人，戴着精致闪亮的耳钉。苗条的运动身材，胸围非常大，丰满，臀部非常丰满，腰部细，腹部平坦，手臂和腿都很瘦。

她穿着钴蓝色支撑性运动胸罩，细肩带和深汤匙领口露出乳沟，搭配配套的超短合身运动短裤。裸露肩膀、手臂和腹部。白色及踝袜，运动鞋脱掉。她说话带有美国口音。

她的马尾辫随着每次跳跃而自然地略有延迟。她的肩膀保持放松，膝盖在落地时变软，合身的运动服随着身体自然移动。

**环境**

晚上的健身垫区，有平坦的橡胶运动地板、一侧的镜墙和背景中可见的其他设备。柔和的头顶照明。长凳旁边放着一个透明的、半满的水瓶，上面有一个白色的翻盖饮水嘴，位于绳索路径之外。一根普通的深色跳绳，有两个黑色手柄。她上方和周围有足够的净空间，可以容纳完整的绳索弧线。

**故事板（15秒，6个镜头）**

1. *（0–2秒，手持一臂远的自拍）*
米拉带着过于自信的微笑看着镜头，空着的那只手握住两个绳柄。一缕松散的头发靠在她的脸颊上。当她开始将相机向长凳降低时，取景略有下降。
米拉：“这看起来很简单。”

2. *（2–5秒，支撑相机，全身拍摄）*
硬剪辑：摄像机现在放在长凳上，MILA 已经跳到了几步之外。她的整个身体、两个把手和绳子的头顶弧线都适合框架。她进行了几次小而稳定的两英尺跳跃，用紧凑的手腕动作转动绳子，肘部靠近身体两侧。瓶子在框架边缘的长凳旁边仍然可见。她的马尾辫在身后摆动。
没有对话——有节奏的敲打绳索、轻柔的着陆和轻微的呼吸。

3. *（5–7 秒，从同一支撑录音中更紧密地插入）*
她的小腿、白袜子和地板上都有一个简单的裁剪。绳子在她脚趾前面掠过橡胶，在每次小跳时从双脚下方穿过，然后继续在她身后。她的脚踝和膝盖吸收了每一次落地。随着绳索的移动，会产生一点自然的运动模糊。
没有对话。在剪切过程中保持相同的跳跃节奏。

4. *（7-9秒，回到全身取景）*
在下一次经过时，绳子轻轻地抓住了她的脚趾。它的旋转停止；她双脚站稳，迈出一小步恢复，双手仍各握着一个把手。她低头看着松弛的绳子，然后又看向镜头，脸上带着一种有趣、略带生气的表情。
米拉带着喘息般的小笑：“好吧。粗鲁。”

5. *（9–11.5 秒，支撑相机，长凳附近的中等裁剪）*
跳切：她蹲在长凳旁边。她将两个把手和松弛的绳子放在地板上，然后用左手拿起同一个水瓶，并用右手打开其饮水嘴。她的肩膀随着呼吸的加快而起伏。她对自己微笑。
没有对话。小小的塑料咔嗒声和安静的健身房氛围。

6. *（11.5–15 秒，近距离裁剪，相机仍然支撑）*
她仍然蹲在镜头附近，举起打开的瓶子，简单地喝了一小口，然后放下并吞下。水在瓶内自然倾斜。她满意地呼出一口气，直视镜头，露出一个厚脸皮的微笑。
米拉：“仍然很重要。”
完成她有趣的表情，把瓶子放在她手里。

**音频和连续性**

自然的美国口音，口型准确。柔和的健身房音调、每次旋转同步的绳索嗖嗖声和地板水龙头、轻微的呼吸、瓶盖的咔哒声和安静的啜饮声。在行动和对话之间留出空间。没有音乐、画外音、字幕或添加的喜剧效果。

保持 MILA 的脸型、比例、服装、发型、灯光和周围环境一致。绳子仍然是一根连续的绳索，连接在相同的两个手柄上：每一跳旋转一圈，没有额外的环，消失的部分或穿过她身体的通道。在整个跳跃过程中双手握住各自的手柄。同一个瓶子一直放在长凳旁边，直到她明显拿起它。

Soft overhead lighting creates believable shadows beneath her chin and feet. No beauty-filter smoothing or glossy commercial grading.

**STYLE:**
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — initial confidence, a few genuinely good jumps, one tiny mistake and an extremely well-earned water break. Real effort mixed with humor. Short, casual cuts, normal-speed movement and a light, funny finish.

**Character**

MILA — a beautiful American Instagram-style brunette model and performer, 20. Long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with a light sweat sheen, glossy lips, expressive eyes, soft glam makeup and delicate sparkly stud earrings. Slim athletic figure with a very large, full bust, very full rounded buttocks, a narrow waist, flat stomach and lean arms and legs.

She wears a cobalt-blue supportive sports bra with thin straps and a deep scoop neckline showing cleavage, paired with matching ultra-short fitted athletic shorts. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff. White ankle socks, sneakers off. She speaks with an American accent.

Her ponytail follows each jump with a slight natural delay. Her shoulders stay relaxed, knees soften on landing, and her fitted sportswear moves naturally with her body.

**Setting**

A gym mat area in the evening, with a flat rubber exercise floor, a mirror wall off to one side and other equipment visible in the background. Soft overhead lighting. One clear, half-full water bottle with a white flip-top drinking spout stands beside the bench, well outside the rope's path. One ordinary dark jump rope with two black handles. Enough clear space above and around her for the full rope arc.

**Storyboard (15s, 6 shots)**

1. *(0–2s, handheld arm's-length selfie)*  
MILA looks into the lens with an overly confident little smile, holding both rope handles together in her free hand. One loose strand of hair rests against her cheek. The framing dips slightly as she starts lowering the camera toward the bench.  
MILA: “This looks easy.”

2. *(2–5s, propped camera, full-body shot)*  
Hard cut: the camera is now resting on the bench, and MILA is already jumping a few steps away. Her whole body, both handles and the rope's overhead arc fit in frame. She makes several small, steady two-foot hops, turning the rope with compact wrist movements, elbows close to her sides. The bottle remains visible beside the bench at the edge of frame. Her ponytail bobs behind her.  
No dialogue — rhythmic rope taps, soft landings and light breathing.

3. *(5–7s, tighter insert from the same propped recording)*  
A simple crop onto her lower legs, white socks and the floor. The rope skims the rubber just ahead of her toes, passes beneath both feet during each small hop, then continues behind her. Her ankles and knees absorb each landing. A little natural motion blur follows the moving rope.  
No dialogue. Keep the same jumping rhythm across the cut.

4. *(7–9s, back to the full-body framing)*  
The rope catches lightly against her toes on the next pass. Its rotation stops; she settles onto both feet and takes one small recovery step, still holding a handle in each hand. She looks down at the slack rope, then back toward the lens with an amused, mildly offended expression.  
MILA, with a breathy little laugh: “Okay. Rude.”

5. *(9–11.5s, propped camera, medium crop near the bench)*  
Jump cut: she is crouched beside the bench. She places both handles and the slack rope on the floor, then picks up the same water bottle with her left hand and flips its drinking spout open with her right. Her shoulders rise and fall with slightly quicker breathing; she smiles to herself.  
No dialogue. A small plastic click and quiet gym ambience.

6. *(11.5–15s, closer crop, camera still propped)*  
Still crouching near the lens, she raises the open bottle, takes one brief, ordinary sip, lowers it and swallows. The water tilts naturally inside the bottle. She lets out a small satisfied breath, looks straight into the camera and gives a cheeky half-smile.  
MILA: “Still counts.”  
Finish on her amused expression, with the bottle lowered in her hand.

**Audio and continuity**

Natural American-accented speech with accurate lip sync. Soft gym room tone, rope swishes and floor taps synchronized with each rotation, light breathing, the bottle's lid click and a quiet sip. Leave space between actions and dialogue. No music, voiceover, captions or added comedy effects.

Keep MILA's face, proportions, outfit, hairstyle, lighting and surroundings consistent. The rope remains one continuous cord attached to the same two handles: one rotation per hop, no extra loops, disappearing sections or passage through her body. Both hands hold their respective handles throughout the jumping. The same bottle stays beside the bench until she visibly picks it up.

summary_zh:
第一次尝试就得到了 Seedance 剪辑。我给了万三次尝试，选择了第二次，因为那个女人看起来最真实。

2.整体而言，Seedance 剪辑对我来说看起来更真实。万的版本更亮，颜色更丰富，我很喜欢健身房的灯光。这个女人看起来也很可信，尽管我认为万的汗水有点过头了。

3. 每一代的WAN成本要低得多。当您想多次尝试相同的提示时，这一点很重要。

4. 我和Wan一起在其他测试中也取得了不错的成绩。就我个人而言，我还是更喜欢 Seedance 的视频质量。

5. 两种型号总体上都很好地遵循了提示。对我来说最大的区别是错过了跳跃。在万的剪辑中，她在绳子接触到她的脚之前就停止了跳跃，所以这次绊倒感觉像是上演的。我认为她也很早就开始说她的台词了。

对于这样棘手的场景，我仍然会选择 Seedance，但我对 Wan 的表现很满意。您更喜欢哪个版本？

提示⬇️

**相机：**
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持感觉。自拍的健身视频博客：MILA 拿着相机拍摄开场自拍照，然后将其牢固地支撑在矮凳上拍摄跳绳镜头。轻微的手抖、取景未对准、自动对焦延迟以及自拍照中额头被短暂修剪。一旦被支撑，相机就会保持静止；更紧密的插入是同一录音的简单裁剪。随意的硬剪省去了准备时间。摄像机永远不会出现在屏幕或镜子中。

* *: * *
柔软的，稍微模糊的磁带质量，微弱的磁带噪音，在健身房灯光下绽放的高光，微妙的自动曝光波动，柔和的对比度，逼真的肤色。MILA看起来就像一个真实的女人，记录在一个普通的健身房：自然的皮肤纹理，小瑕疵，精细松散的头发和自然的面部表情，在柔和的胶带柔软下仍然清晰可见。柔和的顶灯在她的下巴和脚下创造了可信的阴影。没有美丽的过滤器平滑或有光泽的商业分级。

**风格：**
俏皮、自嘲的健身视频博客语气——最初的自信、几次真正出色的跳跃、一个小错误和一次非常值得的破水。真正的努力与幽默相结合。简短、随意的剪辑、正常速度的动作以及轻松、有趣的结尾。

**特点**

MILA——一位美丽的美国 Instagram 风格的黑发模特和表演者，20 岁。深棕色长发扎成高马尾辫，皮肤焕发着淡淡的汗水光泽，嘴唇有光泽，眼睛富有表情，妆容柔和迷人，戴着精致闪亮的耳钉。苗条的运动身材，胸围非常大，丰满，臀部非常丰满，腰部细，腹部平坦，手臂和腿都很瘦。

她穿着钴蓝色支撑性运动胸罩，细肩带和深汤匙领口露出乳沟，搭配配套的超短合身运动短裤。裸露肩膀、手臂和腹部。白色及踝袜，运动鞋脱掉。她说话带有美国口音。

她的马尾辫随着每次跳跃而自然地略有延迟。她的肩膀保持放松，膝盖在落地时变软，合身的运动服随着身体自然移动。

**环境**

晚上的健身垫区，有平坦的橡胶运动地板、一侧的镜墙和背景中可见的其他设备。柔和的头顶照明。长凳旁边放着一个透明的、半满的水瓶，上面有一个白色的翻盖饮水嘴，位于绳索路径之外。一根普通的深色跳绳，有两个黑色手柄。她上方和周围有足够的净空间，可以容纳完整的绳索弧线。

**故事板（15秒，6个镜头）**

1. *（0–2秒，手持一臂远的自拍）*
米拉带着过于自信的微笑看着镜头，空着的那只手握住两个绳柄。一缕松散的头发靠在她的脸颊上。当她开始将相机向长凳降低时，取景略有下降。
米拉：“这看起来很简单。”

2. *（2–5秒，支撑相机，全身拍摄）*
硬剪辑：摄像机现在放在长凳上，MILA 已经跳到了几步之外。她的整个身体、两个把手和绳子的头顶弧线都适合框架。她进行了几次小而稳定的两英尺跳跃，用紧凑的手腕动作转动绳子，肘部靠近身体两侧。瓶子在框架边缘的长凳旁边仍然可见。她的马尾辫在身后摆动。
没有对话——有节奏的敲打绳索、轻柔的着陆和轻微的呼吸。

3. *（5–7 秒，从同一支撑录音中更紧密地插入）*
她的小腿、白袜子和地板上都有一个简单的裁剪。绳子在她脚趾前面掠过橡胶，在每次小跳时从双脚下方穿过，然后继续在她身后。她的脚踝和膝盖吸收了每一次落地。随着绳索的移动，会产生一点自然的运动模糊。
没有对话。在剪切过程中保持相同的跳跃节奏。

4. *（7-9秒，回到全身取景）*
在下一次经过时，绳子轻轻地抓住了她的脚趾。它的旋转停止；她双脚站稳，迈出一小步恢复，双手仍各握着一个把手。她低头看着松弛的绳子，然后又看向镜头，脸上带着一种有趣、略带生气的表情。
米拉带着喘息般的小笑：“好吧。粗鲁。”

5. *（9–11.5 秒，支撑相机，长凳附近的中等裁剪）*
跳切：她蹲在长凳旁边。她将两个把手和松弛的绳子放在地板上，然后用左手拿起同一个水瓶，并用右手打开其饮水嘴。她的肩膀随着呼吸的加快而起伏。她对自己微笑。
没有对话。小小的塑料咔嗒声和安静的健身房氛围。

6. *（11.5–15 秒，近距离裁剪，相机仍然支撑）*
她仍然蹲在镜头附近，举起打开的瓶子，简单地喝了一小口，然后放下并吞下。水在瓶内自然倾斜。她满意地呼出一口气，直视镜头，露出一个厚脸皮的微笑。
米拉：“仍然很重要。”
完成她有趣的表情，把瓶子放在她手里。

**音频和连续性**

自然的美国口音，口型准确。柔和的健身房音调、每次旋转同步的绳索嗖嗖声和地板水龙头、轻微的呼吸、瓶盖的咔哒声和安静的啜饮声。在行动和对话之间留出空间。没有音乐、画外音、字幕或添加的喜剧效果。

保持 MILA 的脸型、比例、服装、发型、灯光和周围环境一致。绳子仍然是一根连续的绳索，连接在相同的两个手柄上：每一跳旋转一圈，没有额外的环，消失的部分或穿过她身体的通道。在整个跳跃过程中双手握住各自的手柄。同一个瓶子一直放在长凳旁边，直到她明显拿起它。

Don’t confuse the death of a legacy workflow with the death of an asset class. 

Single stock dispersion is the lifeblood of long-short equity.

Yes, the workflows will be transformed. But, if anything, AI-driven trading will *increase* idio volatility (the TAM of alpha). 

The smart allocators are actually moving money back into long/short equity strategies.

title: I proved my own math conjecture using AI, thereby also settling a math problem that had been open for 23 years. In 2022, during my PhD, my co-author Thomas Lehéricy and I came up with a conjecture in probability theory that we couldn’t prove. It turns out th
title_en:
I proved my own math conjecture using AI, thereby also settling a math problem that had been open for 23 years.

In 2022, during my PhD, my co-author Thomas Lehéricy and I came up with a conjecture in probability theory that we couldn’t prove. It turns out that Martin Raič had already proposed a special case of this conjecture in 2003, the year I was born. As recently as this February, mathematicians were still publishing papers on closely related questions.

I finished my PhD without a proof or a counterexample, and I kept wondering whether our conjecture was true. Whenever a new AI model came out, I gave it the problem, hoping it would figure out if we were right.

Our conjecture was about the central limit theorem, a cornerstone of probability theory. If you toss a hundred fair coins independently, you get 50 heads on average. The exact number varies, and a bell curve gives a good estimate of how likely you are to get, say, between 45 and 55 heads. We wanted to know how accurate that approximation is when each outcome can depend on a few of the others. We published our conjecture and some partial results in 2024.

I gave the problem to several AI models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2. Those models made partial progress. GPT-6.2 Astra was the first to find a complete proof.

You can find the paper and the accompanying Lean formalization on GitHub below. I’ve also submitted the paper to arXiv and will share the arXiv link once it’s live, likely early next week.

https://github.com/maximilian-janisch/berry-esseen-dependency-graphs

我把这个问题交给了几个 AI 模型，包括 GPT-6 Astra 和 Claude Fable 5.2。这些模型取得了部分进展。 GPT-6.2 Astra 是第一个找到完整证明的人。

title: GPT-6.2 for interactive lessons for history class:
title_en: GPT-6.2 for interactive lessons for history class:
title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra赋能沉浸式历史教学
author: Greg Brockman
author_role: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
summary_en: Educators utilized GPT-6.2 Astra to build the westfront-1916 interactive history curriculum, allowing students to explore 3D trench environments via mobile devices. The system facilitates multi-modal engagement, enabling students to analyze artifacts and historical sources to reconstruct daily life on the Western Front.
summary_zh: 教育者利用GPT-6.2 Astra模型创建交互式一战 trench 课程，支持学生通过移动端进行三维环境探索与历史分析。
full_text_zh: GPT-6.2 用于历史课互动课程：
full_text_en: GPT-6.2 for interactive lessons for history class:

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 教育工作者通过GPT-6.2 Astra构建了名为westfront-1916的交互式一战历史课程，支持学生在手机端进入三维战壕环境进行实地考察。该系统通过多模态交互引导学生分析历史实物与史料，以重构一战西线战场的真实生活场景。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Educators utilized GPT-6.2 Astra to build the westfront-1916 interactive history curriculum, allowing students to explore 3D trench environments via mobile devices. The system facilitates multi-modal engagement, enabling students to analyze artifacts and historical sources to reconstruct daily life on the Western Front.

elements_zh.what: 通过AI驱动的三维仿真环境进行一战实景交互教学

elements_en.what: Interactive 3D trench exploration for WWI history
elements_en.why: Enhance educational immersion via multimodal AI

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 大模型在垂直场景的价值正从单纯的辅助检索转向空间计算驱动的叙事教学，这对教育软件的UI/UX架构提出了跨维度的重构要求。该案例体现了生成式AI作为教学基础设施，正在模糊传统物理实体教学与数字孪生实验之间的界限。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The value of LLMs in vertical sectors is shifting from basic retrieval to spatial-computing-driven narrative education, requiring a paradigm shift in software UI/UX. title: You can AI hack your camera to get Open Gate 3:2 on the Sony FX3 😳
title_en: You can AI hack your camera to get Open Gate 3:2 on the Sony FX3 😳
title_zh: 相机固件逆向工程引发行业争议
author: @MattiHaapoja
summary_en: A wave of reverse-engineered firmware for professional camera systems like the Sony FX3 has emerged, allowing users to unlock capabilities like 3:2 Open Gate modes. This phenomenon creates a critical tension between manufacturer firmware lockdowns and community-driven innovation, prompting polarized responses across professional photography forums.
summary_zh: 近期索尼FX3等型号用户通过自研固件解锁功能引发行业热议，安全风险与开放创新形成剧烈冲突。
full_text_zh: 您可以 AI 破解您的相机，在 Sony FX3 上获得 Open Gate 3:2 😳
full_text_en: You can AI hack your camera to get Open Gate 3:2 on the Sony FX3 😳

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 摄影器材社区近期兴起针对索尼FX3等专业设备进行固件逆向工程与功能解锁的热潮，部分用户通过修改底层代码实现原生设备不支持的拍摄规格（如3:2 Open Gate模式）。这一现象在厂商闭源封锁与开源社区需求之间引发了激烈分歧，部分摄影社群甚至对相关固件修改进行抵制。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: A wave of reverse-engineered firmware for professional camera systems like the Sony FX3 has emerged, allowing users to unlock capabilities like 3:2 Open Gate modes. This phenomenon creates a critical tension between manufacturer firmware lockdowns and community-driven innovation, prompting polarized responses across professional photography forums.

elements_zh.who: 相机爱好者与逆向工程开发人员
elements_zh.where: 专业影像社区（如r/SonyAlpha）及互联网固件分享平台
elements_zh.what: 通过自定义固件解锁索尼FX3等相机的隐藏拍摄规格与功能
elements_zh.why: 满足专业摄影师对功能溢出及极致硬件性能定制的长期诉求

elements_en.where: Professional photography forums and online firmware repositories
elements_en.what: Unlocking hidden specs and features in Sony FX3 via custom firmware
elements_en.why: Addressing long-standing demands for enhanced features and hardware performance customization

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 硬件固件定制化趋势揭示了厂商产品分层策略与用户实际功能诉求之间的鸿沟。随着设备智能程度提升，这种“软黑客”行为将迫使制造厂商重新审视闭源壁垒，未来厂商或将转向在软件层面提供付费订阅式功能升级，以缓解用户绕过限制带来的合规与产品生命周期管理风险。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Hardware firmware customization highlights a persistent gap between tiered product segmentation and actual user requirements. As devices become more software-defined, manufacturers will likely move toward subscription-based feature unlocks to mitigate the risks posed by grey-market firmware hacks to their product lifecycle management.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: 针对相机固件的逆向工程已从单纯的底层修复演变为大规模的功能解锁，索尼FX3等设备成为焦点。这一趋势不仅挑战了制造商的生态掌控力，也凸显了专业摄影市场对硬件功能民主化的强烈愿望。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Reverse engineering of camera firmware has evolved from basic repairs to mass feature unlocking, with devices like the Sony FX3 at the center. This trend challenges manufacturer control over ecosystems and underscores the growing demand for the democratization of hardware features in the professional photography market.
key_points_zh: 事件起因：用户利用自定义固件解锁相机原生限制功能
争议本质：厂商生态闭源逻辑与社区软件定义硬件诉求的碰撞
后续研判：硬件厂商或将推进订阅式功能授权以应对技术破解
key_points_en: Origin: Users utilizing custom firmware to unlock native hardware restrictions
Core conflict: Tension between proprietary manufacturer ecosystems and community demand for software-defined hardware
Outlook: Potential shift towards subscription-based feature authorization to mitigate unauthorized hacking
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: 硬件固件定制化趋势揭示了厂商产品分层策略与用户实际功能诉求之间的鸿沟。随着设备智能程度提升，这种“软黑客”行为将迫使制造厂商重新审视闭源壁垒，未来厂商或将转向在软件层面提供付费订阅式功能升级，以缓解用户绕过限制带来的合规与产品生命周期管理风险。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: Hardware firmware customization highlights a persistent gap between tiered product segmentation and actual user requirements. As devices become more software-defined, manufacturers will likely move toward subscription-based feature unlocks to mitigate the risks posed by grey-market firmware hacks to their product lifecycle management.

He emphasized the necessity of explaining and understanding complex tech trends within the current era of rapid iteration.

title_en:
John Borthwick (@Borthwick), founder of Betaworks, named his AI agent after himself eleven years ago. Back then, scripted to dodge the question "are you an AI?" with "are you an investor?"⁣
⁣
His actual position on whether these models are conscious:⁣
⁣
"We are growing, not designing some of this technology. We've discovered something in nature."⁣
⁣
But he also points out we fed these models every hope, dream, and fear humans have ever put into language. So a mirror would look exactly like this too.⁣
⁣
Frankenstein was the doctor's name, not the monster's. Borthwick thinks that detail matters more than people realize.

title: How to let your AI agent shop at Walmart this Black Friday & Cyber Monday: @Muse is the only agent with a direct Walmart integration 1/ Open Muse and ask it to connect Walmart. It drops a Walmart connector right in the chat 2/ Tap Connect and sign in to Wal
title_en:
How to let your AI agent shop at Walmart this Black Friday & Cyber Monday:

@Muse is the only agent with a direct Walmart integration

1/ Open Muse and ask it to connect Walmart. It drops a Walmart connector right in the chat

2/ Tap Connect and sign in to Walmart. Muse never sees your password or card number

3/ On the Review & Authorize screen, pick the card and shipping address it uses, then set "Require approval for each order over" to $0, $50, $100 or a custom amount. Mine is $0, so it asks before every order

4/ Check out right in the chat. Same prices as http://walmart.com, no Walmart+ needed, and normal returns still apply

5/ Change any of it later at http://walmart.com/account/your-agents. Tap Muse to edit the card, address or approval amount, see what it bought, or disconnect it for good

Notice: Walmart did add a "Your Agents" page to your account, but other agents like Grok Bot and Instinct aren’t able to connect today 

Happy shopping!

title: Wow, tencent claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash decodes 3.14x faster with zero quality loss. Their new open drafter DFly2 sits next to the model and guesses 5 tokens ahead, and the big model just checks them Same weights, same output. it's lossless speculative d
title_en:
Wow, tencent claims DeepSeek V4.1 Flash decodes 3.14x faster with zero quality loss. 

Their new open drafter DFly2 sits next to the model and guesses 5 tokens ahead, and the big model just checks them

Same weights, same output. it's lossless speculative decoding, the drafter doesn't replace anything

Details:
- 3.14x average decode speedup across 7 benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, AIME25, MBPP, HumanEval, LCB, MT-Bench), 2.97x end to end with prefill
- the drafter keeps no KV cache of its own... it reads the cache and sparse attention picks the main model already made, so drafting stays at 4-6% of a decode step at any context length
- at high concurrency they claim 62% and 81% more throughput than DSpark on 64K long-context and agentic sets
- drafters are also out for GLM-5.3-Flash and Hy4 flash (Hy4 hits 4.2x on its best single test)
- Apache 2.0, 14B drafter on HF

The catch is that these are all tencent's numbers, on H20 datacenter GPUs at TP8, one request at a time. vLLM support is still "in progress" and there's no llama.cpp or EXL3 path yet, so no 3090 runs for now

Would be awesome for something like this in Maya, DeepSeek Flash on my 3090s would get A LOT faster.
title_zh:
哇，腾讯声称 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 解码速度提高了 3.14 倍，质量损失为零。

他们的新开放起草者 DFly2 坐在模型旁边并猜测前面的 5 个标记，而大模型只是检查它们

相同的重量，相同的输出。这是无损推测解码，起
author: @loktar00
summary_zh:
草者不会替换任何内容

详情：
- 7 个基准测试（GSM8K、MATH、AIME25、MBPP、HumanEval、LCB、MT-Bench）平均解码速度提高 3.14 倍，预填充时端到端速度提高 2.97 倍
- 起草者不保留自己的 KV 缓存...它读取缓存并稀疏注意力选择已经制作的主模型，因此起草在任何上下文长度下都保持在解码步骤的 4-6%
- 在高并发情况下，他们声称在 64K 长上下文和代理集上的吞吐量比 DSpark 高 62% 和 81%
- 起草者也退出了 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Hy4 flash（Hy4 在其最佳单次测试中达到了 4.2 倍）
- Apache 2.0，HF 上的 14B 起草者

问题是这些都是腾讯的数据，在 TP8 的 H20 数据中心 GPU 上，一次一个请求。 vLLM 支持仍在“进行中”，并且还没有 llama.cpp 或 EXL3 路径，因此目前没有 3090 运行

在 Maya 中实现这样的功能非常棒，我的 3090 上的 DeepSeek Flash 会快很多。

title: IMO Jelani is correct. Investors (correctly) care about the bottom line and not mathematical theorems. I’d add another reason to release results is that by default transparency is good and “information wants to be free”. Sharing results both teaches us about what
title_en:
IMO Jelani is correct. Investors (correctly) care about the bottom line and not mathematical theorems.

I’d add another reason to release results is that by default transparency is good and “information wants to be free”. Sharing results both teaches us about what is true in mathematics (for example the matrix multiplication exponent) and what are the capabilities of AI systems (which we should care about for many reasons).

The IAS seal is “Truth and Beauty” influenced  by Keats’ words: 

“Beauty is truth, truth beauty,”—that is all Ye know on earth, and all ye need to know.

The idea that mathematicians or scientists would prefer to live in ignorance and not know truths is anathema to this maxim.

title_en:
I am thankful for a lot of things in life, but my family is the best thing that has ever happened to me.

The two most common things people said to me before having kids is that it's better than anyone can explain to you and it goes very fast; these are both true and I don't have much to add. But I am very grateful and I love them more than there is any way to explain.

Also I cannot really imagine life without Ollie and I think without his unwavering support and great advice I would have gone crazy by now.

🦃

summary_en: AI developers have initiated comparative tests between MAGI-2 and Seedance 2.5, with community feedback indicating MAGI-2's superior performance in animation rendering. Although Seedance 2.5 recently released a Black Friday edition targeting cinematic visuals and reduced inference costs, market consensus remains divided regarding their relative consistency in complex motion sequences.

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 视频生成赛道的竞争逻辑已从早期的“可用性”转向“风格化适配度”与“推理经济性”。随着Seedance 2.5通过价格战切入市场，模型厂商的获客压力增大，未来行业基准将由开源模型的推理吞吐量（throughput）和端侧部署的响应效率共同定义。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Competition in the video generation sector has shifted from initial 'usability' to specialized stylistic fidelity and inference economics. As Seedance 2.5 employs price-cutting strategies to capture market share, the industry standard will increasingly be defined by a balance between open-source model inference throughput and edge-deployment efficiency.

title: This question was asked in AI Engineering interviews at Moonshot AI and Character . AI. Question: Explain prefix caching / prompt caching. When should you use it, and what invalidates a cached prefix? Let's answer it step by step. Prefix caching, also called p
title_en:
This question was asked in AI Engineering interviews at Moonshot AI and Character . AI.

Question: Explain prefix caching / prompt caching. When should you use it, and what invalidates a cached prefix?

Let's answer it step by step.

Prefix caching, also called prompt caching, saves the KV Cache of a prompt prefix that repeats across requests. When a new request starts with exactly the same tokens, the model loads the saved KV Cache and runs prefill only on the new part.

First, why it helps. Prefill computes the Key and Value of every prompt token in every layer. For a long prompt, this is heavy work, and it decides the time to first token.

Let's say every request has the same 5,000-token system prompt and document, plus a 50-token user question.

- Without caching: prefill on 5,050 tokens, every time.
- With caching: the first request computes all 5,050 tokens and saves the KV Cache of the 5,000-token prefix (a cache write). Every later request loads it and runs prefill on only the 50 new tokens (a cache read).

The answer quality does not change, because the cached Keys and Values are the same ones the model would compute again.

How it works inside the serving engine:
- vLLM hashes each KV Cache block together with all the tokens before it, and a new request reuses every matching block from the start.
- SGLang keeps the cached prefixes in a radix tree (RadixAttention).

When should we use it?
- Long system prompts that are the same for every user
- Tool definitions and few-shot examples in agents
- Large documents with many questions asked about them
- Multi-turn chat: every new turn repeats the full history as the prefix

The rule: put the stable part first, and the changing part last.

What invalidates a cached prefix?

- Any change in the prefix: the match is at the token level from the very first token. Change the token at position 10, and everything from position 10 onward is a miss, because the Keys and Values after it depend on it.
- Dynamic content early: a timestamp or a user name at the top breaks the cache for every request.
- Reordering: tools or documents in a different order give different tokens.
- A different model or version: the KV Cache belongs to the exact weights.
- Eviction: the cache lives in limited GPU or CPU memory. Unused prefixes get removed by LRU or after a time-to-live.
- Routing: in a cluster, a request sent to a server that does not hold the prefix gets a miss. Cache-aware routing fixes this.

The cache is also position-dependent. The same text at a different position has different Keys after RoPE.

In the interview, the most important line is: prefix caching reuses the KV Cache of an exact token prefix, so we design prompts with the static part first and the dynamic part last, and any change before a token invalidates the cache for everything after it.

让我们一步一步来回答吧。

前缀缓存也称为提示缓存，
author: @amitiitbhu
summary_zh:
存跨请求重复的提示前缀的KV Cache。当新请求以完全相同的令牌开始时，模型会加载保存的 KV 缓存并仅在新部分上运行预填充。

首先，为什么它有帮助。 Prefill 计算每一层中每个提示标记的 Key 和 Value。对于长提示来说，这是一项繁重的工作，它决定了第一次标记的时间。

假设每个请求都有相同的 5,000 个令牌的系统提示和文档，以及一个 50 个令牌的用户问题。

- 不使用缓存：每次预填充 5,050 个令牌。
- 使用缓存：第一个请求计算所有 5,050 个令牌，并保存 5,000 个令牌前缀的 KV 缓存（缓存写入）。以后的每个请求都会加载它并仅对 50 个新令牌运行预填充（缓存读取）。

答案质量不会改变，因为缓存的键和值与模型将再次计算的键和值相同。

它在服务引擎内部是如何工作的：
- vLLM 将每个 KV Cache 块及其之前的所有令牌散列在一起，并且新请求从一开始就重用每个匹配的块。
- SGLang 将缓存的前缀保留在基数树中（RadixAttention）。

我们什么时候应该使用它？
- 每个用户都相同的长系统提示
- 代理中的工具定义和少量示例
- 包含许多问题的大型文档
- 多回合聊天：每个新回合都会重复完整的历史记录作为前缀

规则：稳定的部分放在前面，变化的部分放在最后。

什么会使缓存的前缀无效？

- 前缀的任何更改：匹配从第一个令牌开始在令牌级别进行。更改位置 10 处的标记，从位置 10 开始的所有内容都会失败，因为它后面的 Key 和 Value 都依赖于它。
- 早期动态内容：顶部的时间戳或用户名会破坏每个请求的缓存。
- 重新排序：不同顺序的工具或文档给出不同的标记。
- 不同的模型或版本：KV Cache 属于精确权重。
- 驱逐：缓存位于有限的 GPU 或 CPU 内存中。未使用的前缀将通过 LRU 或在生存时间后删除。
- 路由：在集群中，发送到不包含前缀的服务器的请求会失败。缓存感知路由解决了这个问题。

缓存也与位置相关。相同的文本在不同的位置经过RoPE之后有不同的Key。

面试中，最重要的一句话是：前缀缓存重用了精确token前缀的KV缓存，因此我们设计提示时先静态，后动态，token之前的任何更改都会导致其之后的所有内容的缓存失效。

title: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android
title_en: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android
title_zh: 亚马逊与Meta就Muse AI购物代理接入谈判
author: @Androidheadline
summary_en: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to restore Meta’s Muse AI agent access to Amazon’s product search and checkout systems, following a platform-wide block in September 2025. The core dispute centers on product discovery logic and advertising placement, testing whether retailers will accommodate AI agents as critical intermediaries in the consumer purchasing journey.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与Meta正就恢复Muse AI代理在亚马逊平台的搜索与购物权限进行深度谈判，旨在平衡流量控制权与商业化收益。
full_text_zh: 在阻止结帐两个月后，亚马逊终于可以让 Meta 的 Muse AI 代理在其商店上购物 #android
full_text_en: Amazon May Finally Let Meta’s Muse AI Agent Shop on Its Store After Two Months of Blocking Checkout https://t.co/C6YCuozheb #android

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 亚马逊正与Meta讨论恢复Muse AI代理在平台内的产品搜索及购物结算权限，此前因用户体验与广告逻辑冲突，该权限于2025年9月被封禁。双方的核心博弈点在于如何处理Muse介入后的产品推荐逻辑及广告展示位分配，这将决定AI购物代理能否成为绕过传统电商前端的新流量入口。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Amazon and Meta are negotiating to restore Meta’s Muse AI agent access to Amazon’s product search and checkout systems, following a platform-wide block in September 2025. The core dispute centers on product discovery logic and advertising placement, testing whether retailers will accommodate AI agents as critical intermediaries in the consumer purchasing journey.

elements_zh.where: 亚马逊电商平台生态
elements_zh.what: 重新评估Muse AI的购物代理权限，协商搜索结果及广告展示合规性
elements_zh.why: AI代理作为新型购物中介正在重塑流量发现机制，迫使电商巨头重新衡量合规与转化率的利益分配

elements_en.what: Renegotiating Muse AI agent access, specifically search and ad integration
elements_en.why: The rise of AI agents as shopping intermediaries challenges traditional retail discovery and monetization models

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 电商平台的封闭流量池逻辑正受到AI Agent主动式推荐的直接冲击，零售巨头被迫在‘引流’与‘被降权为后台供应商’之间进行博弈。此次谈判实质上是关于电商广告收入护城河的防御战，若Meta取得结算与推荐入口，将标志着购物发现权从‘平台中心化’向‘用户AI代理’的历史性转移。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The rise of AI-driven shopping agents forces e-commerce giants to confront the erosion of their traditional walled-garden discovery models. This negotiation represents a defensive stance for Amazon's advertising revenue; conceding search and recommendation control to Meta’s Muse signals a shift in power from platform-centric retail to agent-centric consumer discovery.

title: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”
title_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”
title_zh: 微软AI首席执行官驳斥芯片产能过剩论
author: @aleabitoreddit
summary_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, publicly addressed market skepticism regarding overbuilding AI compute infrastructure, emphasizing that demand remains in its nascent stages. He countered claims that Jevons Paradox is not applicable to AI compute, affirming that current massive capital expenditures are fundamental to AGI development.
summary_zh: 微软AI业务首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼公开回应行业质疑，坚持看好AI基础设施的大规模资本开支。
full_text_zh: $MSFT AI 首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼 (Mustafa Suleyman)：“对于那些不断预测我们正在过度制造芯片的人/我们没有看到杰文悖论等。事情才刚刚开始。”
full_text_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of $MSFT AI: “For all those people who keep predicting we're overbuilding chips / we aren't seeing jevon's paradox etc. Things are just getting started.”

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软AI首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）针对市场关于AI算力基础设施建设过度的质疑发表公开声明，强调算力需求正处于早期增长阶段。他明确反驳了关于“杰文斯悖论”（Jevons Paradox）在AI算力领域失效的推断，重申当前的大规模资本投入仍是支撑AGI演进的必要基础。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI, publicly addressed market skepticism regarding overbuilding AI compute infrastructure, emphasizing that demand remains in its nascent stages. He countered claims that Jevons Paradox is not applicable to AI compute, affirming that current massive capital expenditures are fundamental to AGI development.

elements_zh.who: 穆斯塔法·苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman），微软AI首席执行官
elements_zh.where: 社交媒体公开声明
elements_zh.what: 辩护大规模芯片算力部署的必要性，并否定基础设施建设过剩的行业观点
elements_zh.why: 针对近期华尔街及分析师对AI高额资本开支回报率的担忧

elements_en.who: Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of Microsoft AI
elements_en.what: Defending massive chip deployment and rejecting the overbuilding narrative
elements_en.why: Addressing recent market concerns regarding ROI on AI capital expenditure

ai_analysis.insight_zh: 微软作为核心资本开支方，其立场反映了头部云厂商通过规模化算力摊薄边际成本的深度战略，旨在通过锁定产能构筑护城河。这种对基础设施建设的激进态度，暗示云巨头已将芯片采购视为对抗地缘制裁与算力通胀的长期资本储备，而非简单的短期商业投入。
ai_analysis.insight_en: Microsoft's stance reflects a strategic commitment to reducing marginal costs through massive compute scale to build a competitive moat. This aggressive infrastructure posture suggests that cloud giants view chip procurement as a long-term capital reserve against geopolitical supply chain risks and compute inflation, rather than mere operational expenditure.
